components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Default call to action. Solid Archive Navy fill.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { font-size: 16px; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid transparent; background: var(--color-primary, #1e3a8a); color: var(--color-text-on-primary, #ffffff); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--color-primary-hover, #1e40af); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-primary, #1e3a8a); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: 0.6; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Ghost variant for lower-emphasis actions (e.g. logout).
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { font-size: 16px; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; color: var(--color-primary, #1e3a8a); border: 1px solid var(--color-border, #e2e8f0); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--color-bg-subtle, #f8fafc); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-primary, #1e3a8a); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Card
components.css: .ds-card { background: var(--color-bg, #ffffff); border: 1px solid var(--color-border, #e2e8f0); border-radius: 8px; box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.08), 0 1px 2px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.06); padding: 24px; }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Labeled text input, used across forms.
components.css: .ds-input-group { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; } .ds-input-label { font-size: 14px; color: var(--color-text-muted, #64748b); } .ds-input { font-size: 16px; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid var(--color-border, #e2e8f0); color: var(--color-text, #1e293b); background: var(--color-bg, #ffffff); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-primary, #1e3a8a); outline-offset: 1px; border-color: var(--color-primary, #1e3a8a); } .ds-input:disabled { background: var(--color-bg-subtle, #f8fafc); cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Auth Side Panel
components.description: Signature element of the login/reset-password surface: gradient panel with an 80px asymmetric corner. Auth-specific, not a system-wide pattern.
components.html:
Bienvenido a Nexia

Consulta y gestiona los proyectos de investigación de tu colegio.
components.css: .ds-auth-side { border-radius: 80px 0 0 80px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--color-primary, #1e3a8a), var(--color-primary-hover, #1e40af)); color: var(--color-text-on-primary, #ffffff); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex-direction: column; padding: 40px; text-align: center; } .ds-auth-side h2 { font-size: 20px; font-weight: 700; margin: 0 0 8px; } .ds-auth-side p { font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.4; opacity: 0.9; margin: 0; }

narrative.overview: Nexia reads like the registrar's office of a well-run school: formal enough to hold institutional weight — grades, evaluations, minors' data — but never cold enough to intimidate the 16-17 year old students who log in to manage their own capstone project. Every surface is built from a small, disciplined vocabulary (one primary color, one reserved accent, one type family, one radius) so that per-school theming later is a token swap, not a redesign. The system is deliberately quiet at rest. Structure and whitespace carry the hierarchy; color is spent sparingly and with intent. The one confirmed visual rejection so far: no third color, no decorative flourishes competing with the primary blue.
keyCharacteristics: Single institutional blue as the only color with real visual weight.
Amber accent reserved for state/attention, never decoration — rare by design.
One type family, differentiated by size and weight, not by swapping fonts.
Flat by default; a two-step shadow vocabulary signals elevation only where it's earned.
Approachable-but-authoritative tone: professional documents, not a playful consumer app.

rules.name: The Amber Reserve Rule
rules.body: Registrar Amber appears on less than 10% of any given screen, and only to mean "this needs attention" (status, pending, warning). It never decorates. Its rarity is what makes it legible as a signal.

dos: Do keep Registrar Amber under 10% of any screen, reserved for status/attention only (The Amber Reserve Rule).
Do use the two-step shadow vocabulary (Resting / Floating) for any new elevated surface instead of inventing a new shadow value.
Do give h1 an explicit --font-size-xl (Display, 28px/700) instead of relying on the browser's default heading size.
Do promote Ink Red (#b91c1c) to a --color-error custom property before reusing it outside AuthLayout.css.
donts: Don't extend the Auth Panel's 80px asymmetric radius or sliding-panel treatment to other screens yet — it's a confirmed auth-only pattern, not a system-wide signature.
Don't add a third color with real visual weight. The palette is Primary + Neutral, with Registrar Amber held in reserve.
Don't let the reset-password panel gain a "back to login" affordance from the UI layer; the no-escape behavior is a security decision, not an oversight to fix.
